questions.prompt: What sweet liquid do worker bees collect?
questions.evidenceText: They collect a sweet liquid from inside flowers. This liquid is called nectar.

questions.prompt: Why is moving pollen between flowers important?
choices: it helps flowers hold more nectar
questions.evidenceText: When the bee visits the next flower, some pollen falls off. This helps plants make seeds.

questions.prompt: Which action does the book recommend to help bees?
questions.evidenceText: We can help bees by planting flowers.
